# Set up and read files

```{r setup}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

# Load packages
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(psych)
library(DT)
library(nlme)
library(apaTables)

# Clear work space
rm(list = ls())

# Set system language
Sys.setenv(LANG = "en")

# Read file
task_filename <- "../Original data/Prosocial_Motivation_Raw_Data.csv"
mot_raw <- read.csv(task_filename, header = TRUE)

# Remove headers (rows 2 and 3)
mot_raw <- mot_raw[-c(1, 2), ]

# Delete unfinished responses
mot_raw <- mot_raw[mot_raw$Finished != 0, ]

# Convert columns to numeric
mot_raw[] <- lapply(mot_raw, function(x) {
  # Try converting to numeric
  num <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(as.character(x)))
  # If conversion creates too many NAs, keep original
  if (sum(is.na(num)) < length(num) / 3)
    num
  else
    x
})

```

# Change goals
## Condition orders

Participants were randomized into two conditions distinguished by the order in which they completed the two motivational interventions (Psychoeducation and Feedback). All participants completed both interventions and reported their motivation to become more prosocial after each intervention. 

This block names the change goal variables based on the order of the psychoeducation and feedback conditions participants experienced.

```{r orders}
# The initial motivation response
mot_raw <- mot_raw %>%
  rename(change_goal_initial = Pro_change)

# Motivation after feedback:
mot_raw <- mot_raw %>%
  rename(change_goal_post_feedback = Pro_change_feedback)

# Motivation after psychoed:
mot_raw <- mot_raw %>%
  rename(change_goal_post_psychoed = Pro_change_reflect)

# ----- Order of presenting the feedback and psychoed blocks -----
# FL21: Feedback
# FL20: psychoed
# If FL21|FL20, feedback condition is presented first, feedback_first = 1, initial -> feedback -> psychoed
# If FL20|FL21, relection condition is presented first,feedback_first = 0, initial -> psychoed -> feedback
mot_raw$feedback_first <- as.integer(ifelse(mot_raw$FL_13_DO == "FL_21|FL_20", 1, 0))

# ----- Motivation before psychoed -----
# If feedback first = 0, then the initial motivation is the pre-psychoed motivation
# If feedback first = 1, then the post feedback motivation is the pre-psychoed motivation
mot_raw$change_goal_pre_psychoed <- ifelse(
  mot_raw$feedback_first == 0,
  mot_raw$change_goal_initial,
  mot_raw$change_goal_post_feedback
)

# ----- Motivation before feedback -----
# If feedback first = 0, then the post psychoed motivation is the pre-feedback motivation
# If feedback first = 1, then the initial motivation is the pre-feedback motivation
mot_raw$change_goal_pre_feedback <- ifelse(
  mot_raw$feedback_first == 0,
  mot_raw$change_goal_post_psychoed,
  mot_raw$change_goal_initial
)

# ----- Final motivation -----
# If feedback first = 0, then the post feedback motivation is the final motivation
# If feedback first = 1, then the post psychoed motivation is the final motivation
mot_raw$change_goal_final <- ifelse(
  mot_raw$feedback_first == 0,
  mot_raw$change_goal_post_feedback,
  mot_raw$change_goal_post_psychoed
)

```

## Center change goals

```{r center change goals}
#---------------------------------
# Center the change goal variables so 0 = no change
#---------------------------------
# Variables to center
vars_to_center <- c(
  # Prosociality change goals
  "change_goal_initial",
  "change_goal_pre_psychoed",
  "change_goal_post_psychoed",
  "change_goal_pre_feedback",
  "change_goal_post_feedback",
  "change_goal_final",
  
  # Prosocial trait change goals
  "honest_change_goal",
  "humble_change_goal",
  "selfless_change_goal",
  "caring_change_goal",
  "moral_change_goal",
  "altruistic_change_goal",
  "helpful_change_goal",
  "generous_change_goal",
  "empathetic_change_goal",
  "compassionate_change_goal",
  "kind_change_goal",
  "considerate_change_goal",
  "cooperative_change_goal"
)

# Center the change goal vars (range 1-7, with 4 being the midpoint)
mot_raw[vars_to_center] <- lapply(mot_raw[vars_to_center], function(x)
  x - 4)

```

# Demographics

```{r demographics}
# ----- Gender -----
mot_raw$gender <- factor(
  mot_raw$gender,
  levels = c(1, 2, 3, 4),
  labels = c ("Female", "Male", "Nonbinary", "Not listed")
)

# ----- Race -----
mot_raw$race = case_when(
  mot_raw$race == 1      ~ "Hispanic",
  mot_raw$race == 2      ~ "White",
  mot_raw$race == 3      ~ "Black",
  mot_raw$race == 4      ~ "American Indian",
  mot_raw$race == 5      ~ "Asian",
  mot_raw$race == 6      ~ "Native Hawaiian",
  mot_raw$race == 7      ~ "Not listed",
  TRUE                 ~ "multiple"
)

mot_raw$race <- factor(
  mot_raw$race,
  levels = c(
    "Hispanic",
    "White",
    "Black",
    "American Indian",
    "Asian",
    "Native Hawaiian",
    "Not listed",
    "multiple"
  )
)

# ----- Income -----
mot_raw$income_categorical = case_when(
  mot_raw$income == 1      ~ "Under $5,000",
  mot_raw$income == 2      ~ "$5,000 - 9,999",
  mot_raw$income == 3      ~ "$10,000 - 14,999",
  mot_raw$income == 4      ~ "$15,000 - 24,999",
  mot_raw$income == 5      ~ "$25,000 - 39,999",
  mot_raw$income == 6      ~ "$40,000 - 59,999",
  mot_raw$income == 7      ~ "$60,000 - 89,999",
  mot_raw$income == 8      ~ "$90,000 - 179,999",
  mot_raw$income == 9      ~ "Over $180,000",
  mot_raw$income == 10     ~ "don't know"
)

mot_raw$income_categorical <- factor(
  mot_raw$income_categorical,
  levels = c(
    "Under $5,000",
    "$5,000 - 9,999",
    "$10,000 - 14,999",
    "$15,000 - 24,999",
    "$25,000 - 39,999",
    "$40,000 - 59,999",
    "$60,000 - 89,999",
    "$90,000 - 179,999",
    "Over $180,000",
    "don't know"
  )
)

# If participant answered "don't know", then code income as NA
mot_raw$income[mot_raw$income == 10] <- NA

```

# Prosociality
## HEXACO
```{r prosocial scores}
# ----- Honesty-humility -----
prosociality_items <- c(
  "HEX_6",
  "HEX_30r",
  "HEX_54",
  "HEX_12r",
  "HEX_36",
  "HEX_60r",
  "HEX_18",
  "HEX_42r",
  "HEX_24r",
  "HEX_48r"
)

# HH_score - prosociality score calculated in Qualtrics
mot_raw$prosociality <- rowMeans(mot_raw[, prosociality_items], na.rm = TRUE)
# HH cronbach's alpha
alpha_prosociality <- psych::alpha(mot_raw[prosociality_items])
alpha_prosociality$total$raw_alpha
# Subscales
mot_raw$prosociality_sincerity <- rowMeans(mot_raw[, c("HEX_6", "HEX_30r", "HEX_54")], na.rm = TRUE)
mot_raw$prosociality_fairness <- rowMeans(mot_raw[, c("HEX_12r", "HEX_36", "HEX_60r")], na.rm = TRUE)
mot_raw$prosociality_greed_avoidance <- rowMeans(mot_raw[, c("HEX_18", "HEX_42r")], na.rm = TRUE)
mot_raw$prosociality_modesty <- rowMeans(mot_raw[, c("HEX_24r", "HEX_48r")], na.rm = TRUE)

```

## TriPM

```{r TriPM}
# There was an error when we programmed Qualtrics, so we need to recode TriPM_26
mot_raw$TriPM_26[mot_raw$TriPM_26 == 4] <- 0

# ----------------------------------------
# Subscales
# ----------------------------------------
meanness_items <- c('TriPM_6', 'TriPM_8', 'TriPM_14', 'TriPM_17', 'TriPM_20', 'TriPM_23',
                    'TriPM_26', 'TriPM_29', 'TriPM_36', 'TriPM_40', 'TriPM_42', 'TriPM_45',
                    'TriPM_48', 'TriPM_55', 'TriPM_2r', 'TriPM_11r', 'TriPM_33r',
                    'TriPM_39r', 'TriPM_52r')
disinhibition_items <- c('TriPM_3', 'TriPM_5', 'TriPM_9', 'TriPM_12', 'TriPM_15', 'TriPM_18',
                         'TriPM_24', 'TriPM_27', 'TriPM_31', 'TriPM_34', 'TriPM_37',
                         'TriPM_43', 'TriPM_46', 'TriPM_49', 'TriPM_51', 'TriPM_53',
                         'TriPM_56', 'TriPM_58', 'TriPM_21r', 'TriPM_30r')
boldness_items <- c('TriPM_1', 'TriPM_7', 'TriPM_13', 'TriPM_19', 'TriPM_22', 'TriPM_28',
                     'TriPM_32', 'TriPM_38', 'TriPM_54', 'TriPM_4r', 'TriPM_10r',
                     'TriPM_16r', 'TriPM_25r', 'TriPM_35r', 'TriPM_41r', 'TriPM_44r',
                     'TriPM_47r', 'TriPM_50r', 'TriPM_57r')
TriPM_total_items <- c(meanness_items, disinhibition_items, boldness_items)

# ----------------------------------------
# Scores
# ----------------------------------------
# Meanness
mot_raw$TriPM_meanness <- rowSums(mot_raw[, meanness_items], na.rm = TRUE)
# Disinhibition
mot_raw$TriPM_disinhibition <- rowSums(mot_raw[, disinhibition_items], na.rm = TRUE)
# Boldness
mot_raw$TriPM_boldness <- rowSums(mot_raw[, boldness_items], na.rm = TRUE)

# Total score
mot_raw$TriPM_total <- rowSums(mot_raw[, c("TriPM_meanness", "TriPM_disinhibition", "TriPM_boldness")], na.rm = TRUE)

# ----------------------------------------
# Cronbach's alpha
# ----------------------------------------
# Total
alpha_TriPM_total <- psych::alpha(mot_raw[TriPM_total_items])
alpha_TriPM_total$total$raw_alpha

# Meanness
alpha_meanness <- psych::alpha(mot_raw[meanness_items])
alpha_meanness$total$raw_alpha
# Disinhibition
alpha_disinhibition <- psych::alpha(mot_raw[disinhibition_items])
alpha_disinhibition$total$raw_alpha
# Boldness
alpha_boldness <- psych::alpha(mot_raw[boldness_items])
alpha_boldness$total$raw_alpha

```

## SDT - short form
```{r SDT}
#---------------------------------
# AUC
#---------------------------------
mot_raw$AUC <- as.numeric(mot_raw$SD1)+ ### 0-1
  ( ((as.numeric(mot_raw$SD1) + as.numeric(mot_raw$SD2) ))/2)+ ###1-2
  ( ((as.numeric(mot_raw$SD2) + as.numeric(mot_raw$SD5) ))*(3/2))+ ###2-5
  ( ((as.numeric(mot_raw$SD5) + as.numeric(mot_raw$SD10) ))*(5/2))+###5-10
  ( ((as.numeric(mot_raw$SD10) + as.numeric(mot_raw$SD20) ))*(10/2))+###10-20
  ( ((as.numeric(mot_raw$SD20) + as.numeric(mot_raw$SD50) ))*(30/2))+##20-50
  ( ((as.numeric(mot_raw$SD50) + as.numeric(mot_raw$SD100) ))*(50/2))##50-100

# Make AUC a range from 0 to 1
mot_raw$AUC <-mot_raw$AUC / 1000

#---------------------------------
# Prep
#---------------------------------
# Rename cols
mot_raw <- mot_raw %>%
  rename(
    "1"   = "SD1",
    "2"   = "SD2",
    "5"   = "SD5",
    "10"  = "SD10",
    "20"  = "SD20",
    "50"  = "SD50",
    "100" = "SD100"
  )

# Create a dataframe with social discounting response and participant IDs only
mot_SD <- mot_raw[, c(
  "participantId",
  "TriPM_total",
  "prosociality",
  "TriPM_meanness",
  "TriPM_boldness",
  "TriPM_disinhibition",
  "1",
  "2",
  "5",
  "10",
  "20",
  "50",
  "100"
)]

# Convert into long format
data_long_sdtsf <- gather(mot_SD, socialdistance, amount, "1":"100", factor_key =
                            FALSE)

# Convert into numeric values
data_long_sdtsf$amount <- as.numeric(data_long_sdtsf$amount)
data_long_sdtsf$socialdistance <- as.numeric(data_long_sdtsf$socialdistance)

#---------------------------------
# Model Comparison - Exponential has the best fit
#---------------------------------
# Hyperbolic model
hyperbolic_model <- nlme(
  amount ~ v0 / (1 + exp(logk) * socialdistance),
  fixed = list(v0 ~ 1, logk ~ 1),
  random = v0 + logk ~ 1 | participantId,
  data = data_long_sdtsf,
  start = c(v0 = 1.6, logk = -2),
  control = c(nlmeControl(tol = .1, msMaxIter = 5000)),
  na.action = na.omit
)
summary(hyperbolic_model)

# Exponential model
exponential_model <- nlme(
  amount ~ v0 * exp(-k * socialdistance),
  fixed = list(v0 ~ 1, k ~ 1),
  random = v0 + k ~ 1 | participantId,
  data = data_long_sdtsf,
  start = c(v0 = 7, k = 1.5),
  control = c(nlmeControl(tol = .1, msMaxIter = 1000)),
  na.action = na.omit
)
summary(exponential_model)

# Linear model
linear <- nlme(
  as.numeric(amount) ~ v0 + k * socialdistance,
  fixed = list(v0 ~ 1, k ~ 1),
  random = v0 + k ~ 1 | participantId,
  data = data_long_sdtsf,
  start = c(v0 = 6, k = -0.6),
  control = nlmeControl(tol = 0.1, msMaxIter = 100000),
  na.action = na.omit
)
summary(linear)

# Compare their AIC, the exponential model has the lowest AIC
AIC(hyperbolic_model)
AIC(exponential_model)
AIC(linear)

#---------------------------------
# Hyperbolic model - logk (for comparison)
#---------------------------------
# Extract the estimated v0 and logk for each individual
ranefs_hyper <- random.effects(hyperbolic_model)

# Get fixed effects
fixed <- fixef(hyperbolic_model)

# Add fixed effect to each individual's random effect
individual_estimates_hyper <- ranefs_hyper
individual_estimates_hyper$v0_estimate <- fixed["v0"] + ranefs_hyper$v0
individual_estimates_hyper$logk_estimate <- fixed["logk"] + ranefs_hyper$logk

# Add ID as a column
individual_estimates_hyper$participantId <- rownames(individual_estimates_hyper)

# Reorder columns
individual_estimates_hyper <- individual_estimates_hyper[, c("participantId", "v0_estimate", "logk_estimate")]
head(individual_estimates_hyper)

# Add comment: do not use for analysis - for comparison only
individual_estimates_hyper <- individual_estimates_hyper %>%
  rename(
    v0_hyperbolic_xuse   = v0_estimate,
    logk_hyperbolic_xuse = logk_estimate
  )

# Add to original dataset
mot_raw <- merge(mot_raw, unclass(individual_estimates_hyper), by = "participantId")

#---------------------------------
# Exponential model - k as discounting rate
#---------------------------------
# Extract random effects from the exponential model
ranefs_exp <- random.effects(exponential_model)  # or ranef(exponential_model)

# Get fixed effects
fixed_exp <- fixef(exponential_model)

# Add fixed effects to each individual's random effects
individual_estimates_exp <- ranefs_exp
individual_estimates_exp$v0_estimate <- fixed_exp["v0"] + ranefs_exp$v0
individual_estimates_exp$k_estimate  <- fixed_exp["k"]  + ranefs_exp$k

# Add ID as a column
individual_estimates_exp$participantId <- rownames(individual_estimates_exp)

# Reorder columns
individual_estimates_exp <- individual_estimates_exp[, c("participantId", "v0_estimate", "k_estimate")]
head(individual_estimates_exp)

# Rename variables
individual_estimates_exp <- individual_estimates_exp %>%
  rename(
    v0_exponential = v0_estimate,
    k_exponential  = k_estimate
  )

# Merge back to the original dataset
mot_raw <- merge(mot_raw, unclass(individual_estimates_exp), by = "participantId")

```

## SDT - short form: Graphs

```{r sdt - high and low psychopathy}
#---------------------------------
# Discounting graph - Full Sample (generated with raw data)
#---------------------------------
filtered_data_long_sdtsf_ggplot <- data_long_sdtsf %>% 
  group_by(socialdistance) %>% 
  summarise(mean_amount=mean(as.numeric(amount)),
            ste=sd(amount)/sqrt(length(amount)))%>% 
  ungroup()

ggplot(filtered_data_long_sdtsf_ggplot, aes(x = socialdistance, y = mean_amount)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 2) +  
  geom_ribbon(
    aes(
      ymin = mean_amount - ste,
      ymax = mean_amount + ste
    ),
    alpha = 0.4,
    color = NA
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Social Discounting with Standard Error",
    x = "Social Distance",
    y = "$ Willing to Forgo",
    fill = "Group"
  ) +
  theme(
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold", margin = margin(t = 20)),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold", margin = margin(r = 20)),
    axis.text.x  = element_text(size = 15),
    axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 15),
    axis.line    = element_line(),
    panel.grid.major  = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor  = element_blank(),
    panel.background  = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "black"),
    plot.background   = element_rect(fill = "white"),
    legend.text  = element_text(size = 15),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 15, face = "bold"),
    legend.justification = c(1, -0.05),
    legend.position      = c(0.9, 0.6),
    legend.background    = element_rect(fill = "white")
  )

#---------------------------------
# Discounting graph - high vs mid vs low TriPM
#---------------------------------
# Create TriPM groups (Low / Mid / High) using tertiles
TriPM_mean <- mean(mot_raw$TriPM_total, na.rm = TRUE)
TriPM_sd   <- sd(mot_raw$TriPM_total, na.rm = TRUE)

data_long_sdtsf_TriPM <- data_long_sdtsf %>%
  mutate(
    TriPM_group = case_when(
      TriPM_total <= (TriPM_mean - TriPM_sd) ~ "Low TriPM",
      TriPM_total >= (TriPM_mean + TriPM_sd) ~ "High TriPM",
      TRUE                                   ~ "Mid TriPM"
    ),
    TriPM_group = factor(TriPM_group,
                         levels = c("Low TriPM", "Mid TriPM", "High TriPM"))
  )

# Summarize by social distance and TriPM group
filtered_data_long_sdtsf_ggplot_triPM <- data_long_sdtsf_TriPM %>%
  group_by(TriPM_group, socialdistance) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_amount = mean(as.numeric(amount), na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Plot three discounting curves
ggplot(filtered_data_long_sdtsf_ggplot_triPM,
       aes(x = socialdistance, y = mean_amount, color = TriPM_group)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 2) +
  labs(
    title = "Social Discounting by TriPM Group",
    x = "Social Distance",
    y = "$ Willing to Forgo",
    color = "TriPM Group"
  ) +
  theme(
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold", margin = margin(t = 20)),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold", margin = margin(r = 20)),
    axis.text.x  = element_text(size = 15),
    axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 15),
    axis.line    = element_line(),
    panel.grid.major  = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor  = element_blank(),
    panel.background  = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "black"),
    plot.background   = element_rect(fill = "white"),
    legend.text  = element_text(size = 15),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 15, face = "bold"),
    legend.justification = c(1, -0.05),
    legend.position      = c(0.9, 0.6),
    legend.background    = element_rect(fill = "white")
  )

#---------------------------------
# Discounting graph - high vs mid vs low TriPM meanness
#---------------------------------
# Create TriPM meanness groups (Low / Mid / High) using mean ± SD thresholds
TriPM_meanness_mean <- mean(mot_raw$TriPM_meanness, na.rm = TRUE)
TriPM_meanness_sd   <- sd(mot_raw$TriPM_meanness, na.rm = TRUE)

data_long_sdtsf_meanness <- data_long_sdtsf %>%
  mutate(
    TriPM_meanness_group = case_when(
      TriPM_meanness <= (TriPM_meanness_mean - TriPM_meanness_sd) ~ "Low Meanness",
      TriPM_meanness >= (TriPM_meanness_mean + TriPM_meanness_sd) ~ "High Meanness",
      TRUE                                                       ~ "Mid Meanness"
    ),
    TriPM_meanness_group = factor(
      TriPM_meanness_group,
      levels = c("Low Meanness", "Mid Meanness", "High Meanness")

# Summarise by social distance and TriPM meanness group
filtered_data_long_sdtsf_ggplot_meanness <- data_long_sdtsf_meanness %>%
  group_by(TriPM_meanness_group, socialdistance) %>%

  geom_line(linewidth = 2) +
  labs(
    title = "Social Discounting by TriPM Boldness Group",
    x = "Social Distance",
    y = "$ Willing to Forgo",
    color = "TriPM Boldness Group"
  ) +
  theme(
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold", margin = margin(t = 20)),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold", margin = margin(r = 20)),
    axis.text.x  = element_text(size = 15),
    axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 15),
    axis.line    = element_line(),
    panel.grid.major  = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor  = element_blank(),
    panel.background  = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "black"),
    plot.background   = element_rect(fill = "white"),
    legend.text  = element_text(size = 15),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 15, face = "bold"),
    legend.justification = c(1, -0.05),
    legend.position      = c(0.9, 0.6),
    legend.background    = element_rect(fill = "white")
  )

#---------------------------------
# Discounting graph - high vs mid vs low TriPM disinhibition
#---------------------------------
# Create TriPM disinhibition groups (Low / Mid / High) using mean ± SD thresholds
TriPM_disinhibition_mean <- mean(mot_raw$TriPM_disinhibition, na.rm = TRUE)
TriPM_disinhibition_sd   <- sd(mot_raw$TriPM_disinhibition, na.rm = TRUE)

data_long_sdtsf_disinhibition <- data_long_sdtsf %>%
  mutate(
    TriPM_disinhibition_group = case_when(
      TriPM_disinhibition <= (TriPM_disinhibition_mean - TriPM_disinhibition_sd) ~ "Low Disinhibition",
      TriPM_disinhibition >= (TriPM_disinhibition_mean + TriPM_disinhibition_sd) ~ "High Disinhibition",
      TRUE                                                                      ~ "Mid Disinhibition"
    ),
    TriPM_disinhibition_group = factor(
      TriPM_disinhibition_group,
      levels = c("Low Disinhibition", "Mid Disinhibition", "High Disinhibition")
    )
  )

# Summarise by social distance and TriPM disinhibition group
filtered_data_long_sdtsf_ggplot_disinhibition <- data_long_sdtsf_disinhibition %>%
  group_by(TriPM_disinhibition_group, socialdistance) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_amount = mean(as.numeric(amount), na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Plot three discounting curves
ggplot(filtered_data_long_sdtsf_ggplot_disinhibition,
       aes(x = socialdistance, y = mean_amount, color = TriPM_disinhibition_group)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 2) +
  labs(
    title = "Social Discounting by TriPM Disinhibition Group",
    x = "Social Distance",
    y = "$ Willing to Forgo",
    color = "TriPM Disinhibition Group"
  ) +
  theme(
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold", margin = margin(t = 20)),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold", margin = margin(r = 20)),
    axis.text.x  = element_text(size = 15),
    axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 15),
    axis.line    = element_line(),
    panel.grid.major  = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor  = element_blank(),
    panel.background  = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "black"),
    plot.background   = element_rect(fill = "white"),
    legend.text  = element_text(size = 15),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 15, face = "bold"),
    legend.justification = c(1, -0.05),
    legend.position      = c(0.9, 0.6),
    legend.background    = element_rect(fill = "white")
  )

#---------------------------------
# Discounting graph - high vs mid vs low prosociality
#---------------------------------
# Create prosociality groups (Low / Mid / High) using mean ± SD thresholds
prosociality_mean <- mean(mot_raw$prosociality, na.rm = TRUE)
prosociality_sd   <- sd(mot_raw$prosociality, na.rm = TRUE)

data_long_sdtsf_prosociality <- data_long_sdtsf %>%
  mutate(
    prosociality_group = case_when(
      prosociality <= (prosociality_mean - prosociality_sd) ~ "Low prosociality",
      prosociality >= (prosociality_mean + prosociality_sd) ~ "High prosociality",
      TRUE                                                  ~ "Mid prosociality"
    ),
    prosociality_group = factor(prosociality_group,
                                levels = c("Low prosociality", "Mid prosociality", "High prosociality"))
  )

# Summarise by social distance and prosociality group
filtered_data_long_sdtsf_ggplot_prosociality <- data_long_sdtsf_prosociality %>%
  group_by(prosociality_group, socialdistance) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_amount = mean(as.numeric(amount), na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Plot three discounting curves
ggplot(filtered_data_long_sdtsf_ggplot_prosociality,
       aes(x = socialdistance, y = mean_amount, color = prosociality_group)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 2) +
  labs(
    title = "Social Discounting by Prosociality Group",
    x = "Social Distance",
    y = "$ Willing to Forgo",
    color = "Prosociality Group"
  ) +
  theme(
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold", margin = margin(t = 20)),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold", margin = margin(r = 20)),
    axis.text.x  = element_text(size = 15),
    axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 15),
    axis.line    = element_line(),
    panel.grid.major  = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor  = element_blank(),
    panel.background  = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "black"),
    plot.background   = element_rect(fill = "white"),
    legend.text  = element_text(size = 15),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 15, face = "bold"),
    legend.justification = c(1, -0.05),
    legend.position      = c(0.9, 0.6),
    legend.background    = element_rect(fill = "white")
  )
```
